name: termbeat
features: Audio from a file or the microphone makes the terminal react to sound.
Terminal themes include paper, hacker, Kali, Android, Linux, Windows and PowerShell.
Modes switch between terminal, visualizer, bars, tetris, snake and pong.
Build mode types source code, and the info panel explains the vision.
overlap: Shares modes and themes with circuit-musicfx. Merge candidate.
